stages.name: Identify Architecture
stages.description: Loads the active architecture profile (e.g. Layered MVC, Clean Arch) and identifies directory layers.

stages.name: Load Rules
stages.description: Loads abstract constraints, severities, and penalty deductions.

stages.name: Apply Language Adapter
stages.description: Applies language-specific regex, AST patterns, and syntax tokens for each file extension.

stages.name: Execute Scan & Parallel Reduction
stages.description: Builds the FileTree and evaluates rules concurrently on the HVM runtime.
